title: HSTU retrieval with user-interest Mirror and candidate-role views
status: FAIL — development stop condition met; fresh not opened
hypothesis: A small role-conditioned Mirror code on the HSTU session/user representation improves held-out genre-conditioned retrieval beyond ordinary HSTU scoring, at better quality-normalized bytes/latency than the same-size ordinary pairwise role gain.
physical_object: One HSTU session encoder and shared item embedding/code substrate.
mirror_coordinate: Per-genre low-description diagonal Givens/scale coordinate m applied to the HSTU user/session vector at late scoring.
logical_multiplicity: Genre/candidate-role-specific retrieval scores from the same session representation and item vectors.
native_prior_art: Meta generative-recommenders HSTU official public implementation; VQ-Rec PA341 item codes, not novelty claim.

development.dataset: MovieLens-1M public ratings/movies; temporally ordered per-user.
development.split: Per-user chronological first 80% train, next 10% development, last 10% fresh; each proposed boundary moves forward to avoid splitting equal-timestamp event groups; minimum 10 events/user.
development.selection_metric: mean per-genre nDCG@10 on development next-item targets; choose by best quality/byte among latency-feasible settings.
development.model: Meta public HSTU, 2 blocks, one head, d=32/dqk=dv=32, max sequence 50; official architecture, reference CPU jagged layout ops
development.training_budget: 8,000 deterministic training examples, 2 epochs, batch 64, 32 sampled negatives, AdamW lr 1e-3; 250 updates per condition
development.methods: native dot-product; 16-code-per-genre pairwise gain; equal-code-count per-genre Givens rotations
development.primary_metric: macro mean of per-genre nDCG@10 on chronological dev next-item retrieval
development.latency_measurement: Interleaved, randomized method order, torch CPU threads=1; 64 identical dev contexts, 768 samples/method; report P50/P95/P99 for full HSTU encoding plus all-item score.
development.decision: FAIL: Givens is lower quality than native HSTU and pair-gain at the fixed budget; P99 is 11.7% slower than pair-gain after interleaved latency replay.

fresh.dataset_split: last 10% chronologically per eligible user, defined before data access
fresh.split_integrity: verify strict timestamp order across split boundaries after moving cuts forward across timestamp ties; no quality metric or model selection uses fresh labels.

controls: Native HSTU single shared session/item dot-product ranker.
HSTU + per-genre pairwise per-dimension gain (same 16-code/role shape as Mirror; actual total payload measured).
HSTU + per-genre dense readout upper reference if feasible.
VQ-Rec-native item-code method was reviewed; implementation unavailable in this open-source checkout, so no direct PA341 reproduction claim.

compute.runtime: CPU batch-1 QPS and P99 under identical candidate sets; no GPU claim.

success_gate: On fresh time-ordered recommendation data, Mirror must improve macro per-role nDCG@10 over native HSTU and the same-code-count pair-gain control, at matched/nearby actual payload bytes and no >10% CPU P99 regression.
failure_gate: FAIL the screen if Mirror loses to native HSTU without a quality/storage/runtime Pareto gain or if same-code-count pair gain matches/beats Mirror quality with lower latency.
boundaries: This is a CPU-scale HSTU application screen; no trillion-parameter/scaling claim.
VQ-Rec is cited PA341 and must be distinguished; this screen does not reproduce its native item quantizer.
Exact official HSTU architecture from Meta source is used with Python equivalents of three FBGEMM jagged tensor ops; those utilities are deterministic layout operations only.

amendments.reason: Freeze implementation dimensions/budget and use equal-weight per-genre aggregation; initial dev code reported micro aggregation, corrected from stored per-role scores without re-running or using fresh outcomes.

amendments.scope: development CPU latency only; before any fresh score evaluation
amendments.reason: Initial P99 varied materially by method under concurrent CPU load. Repeated interleaved replay on identical dev contexts, single-threaded, 768 samples/method; this replaces initial noisy latency estimates for screening.
